pages.text: Gear comes in five rarities, each with its own name color: $(l)Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Mythic$(). Higher rarity means more bonus stats, called $(item)affixes$().$(br2)Chests and monsters drop up to Epic. Bosses drop Rare and better, and only bosses drop Mythic.
Your world tier decides how good drops are. Monsters sometimes drop class gear of your tier, too.$(br2)Hold Shift over a piece of gear to compare it with what you wear.
